name: status
description: Is 3DJames open, and what is in it: project name, file, unsaved changes, number of steps and objects, what the user has selected, and whether they are busy (sketch board open, or making a model editable). Does not open 3DJames.

name: how_to_write_steps
description: The guide to 3DJames project JSON: units and coordinates, every shape kind and its numbers, sketches, combine/move/fillet/pattern steps, variables, colours, and how to name steps so the user can edit them. Read it once before adding or changing steps.

name: list_projects
description: List the projects (and meshes) in the user's 3DJames Projects folder, newest first.

name: open_project
description: Open a project in the 3DJames window: a name from list_projects (".3dj" may be left out) or a full path to a .3dj, .3mf, .json, .stl, .obj or .step file. Returns the project JSON and the build result. Refuses when the open project has unsaved changes, unless discard_changes is true (ask the user first).

name.description: Project name in the Projects folder, or a full path

discard_changes.description: Throw away unsaved changes in the open project (only after the user said so)

name: new_project
description: Start a new, empty project in the 3DJames window. Refuses when the open project has unsaved changes, unless discard_changes is true (ask the user first).

discard_changes.description: Throw away unsaved changes in the open project (only after the user said so)

name: get_project
description: The open project as JSON (vars, bodies, features: the same as project.json in a .3dj), plus the build result.

name: build
description: Build the open project and report: problems (step id, step name, message), each object's size_mm [x,y,z], position (from_mm, to_mm), volume_cm3 and whether it is a solid, and the overall size and volume. Every change tool already returns this.

name: add_steps
description: Add steps to the open project as one Undo step, then build and report. Steps use the same JSON as features in a .3dj (see how_to_write_steps). Leave "id" out to get a free one (f12...); a shape without "body" gets a new object id. Give every new object a name and colour in "objects".

objects.description: Object (body) entries by id, e.g. {"b5":{"name":"Base plate","color":"#22B14C"},"b6":{"name":"Corner hole","color":"#8b96a3","hole":true}}

vars.description: Variables to add or change first, e.g. [{"name":"plateW","expr":"80"}]

after.description: Put the steps after this step id (default: at the end)

name: change_step
description: Change one step as one Undo step, then build and report. Only the fields given change; "p" is merged (so {"p":{"h":30}} changes only the height). A field set to null is removed.

name: delete_steps
description: Delete steps as one Undo step, then build and report (it names later steps that used them).

name: set_vars
description: Add, change or remove project variables as one Undo step, then build and report. Changing a variable is the best way to change a size used in several places.

name: set_objects
description: Change objects (bodies) as one Undo step: name, color (Paint palette, e.g. #00A2E8), hole (true makes it a hole), hidden. A field set to null is removed.

name: replace_project
description: Replace the whole open project with new JSON (vars, bodies, features, name) as one Undo step, then build and report. Use it for a model designed from scratch; use add_steps / change_step for changes.

project.description: The same JSON as project.json in a .3dj: {"name", "vars", "bodies", "features"}

name: undo
description: Undo the last change(s) in 3DJames (like Ctrl+Z), then build and report.

name: picture
description: A picture (PNG) of the model in the 3DJames window, to check it looks right. The view also changes in the user's window.

view.description: Which way to look (default home: from the front left, above)

name: make_editable
description: Make editable: rebuild an STL/OBJ/3MF mesh as editable sketches and steps. Give "file" (a full path, or a name in the Projects folder) to bring it into the open project first, or "object" for a mesh already in it. Can take a few minutes. Reports how close it came (percent the same, largest gap) and which parts stayed meshes.

file.description: Mesh file to bring in: full path or a name in Projects

object.description: Id of an imported mesh object already in the project, e.g. b3

detail.description: How much detail to keep: simple (fewest, plainest steps; may differ by a few tenths of a mm), balanced (far fewer steps, about as close as a printer makes), precise (as close as it gets, more steps). Default: the user's last choice in 3DJames.

name: save_project
description: Save the open project into the user's Projects folder: format 3dj (default, the editable project), or stl / step / 3mf. Refuses to replace an existing file unless overwrite is true, and then the user is asked in 3DJames.

name.description: File name without folder, e.g. "Bracket v2" (default: the project name)

overwrite.description: Replace a file of that name (the user is asked to confirm)
